summary: Match Emoji and Clipboard Search accents, morph the search capsule, and improve password-gesture usability.

changes.title: Search accent across panels
changes.detail: Explicit Emoji and Clipboard Search launchers use the active contextual Apple palette, preserving configured transparency and neutral ordinary keys.

changes.title: Fast Search morph
changes.detail: 135 ms key-to-capsule and capsule-to-key transitions using measured screen coordinates, with cancellation and no full-panel fade or private query snapshots.

changes.title: More forgiving vault recognition
changes.detail: Wider safe start area, start haptic, flexible speed and corner timing, bounded shape alignment, retained enrollment samples and helpful rejection feedback. Encryption, device credential, lockout and masked-field protections unchanged.
